verdict.rationale: There is no documented direct one-to-one send-email endpoint. The evidence shows only an indirect path: a developer posts an event via the Create Event API, and an event-triggered flow then sends branded notifications. That flow path sits on the same API and SDK surface used for marketing campaign creation. missing for 10: a direct transactional send API, explicit transactional email designation or deliverability separation, documented receipt and magic-link use cases, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
